spl:
index=email sourcetype="proofpoint:click" earliest=-24h
| eval verdict=lower(coalesce(verdict, Verdict, ""))
| eval action=lower(coalesce(action, Action, disposition, ""))
| where verdict="malicious"
| stats count(eval(action="allowed" OR action="permitted")) as permitted_clicks count as total_clicks by userPrincipalName, url
| eval permit_rate=round(100*permitted_clicks/nullif(total_clicks,0),1)
| where permitted_clicks>0
| sort -permitted_clicks

detailedImplementation:
Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (TA-proofpoint / Proofpoint Email Security parsing (org deployment) — Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=proofpoint:click into email. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower. Grant the ingestion role `list_inputs` and `search` on the target index.

Step 2 — Create the search and alert

Schedule the SPL with earliest=-24h@h and throttle per entity to avoid duplicate pages. Document tunable macros in the comment header. Understanding this SPL: filters in the first pipeline reduce license cost; stats/timechart aggregates define the alert grain; joins/lookups enrich owner or asset metadata for routing.

Step 3 — Validate

Compare `| tstats count where index=... sourcetype=...` against the vendor admin UI inventory count (+/-5%). Spot-check two known entities for field presence (`permitted_clicks, url, userPrincipalName`). Run `timechart count span=1h` over 7 days to find ingestion gaps longer than two poll intervals.

Step 4 — Operationalize

Add a dashboard row with single-value KPI tiles, a 24-hour timechart, and a drilldown table mirroring the SPL output columns. Route critical severity to the platform on-call channel; route warning to the service owner from the lookup.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting

No events: verify forwarder connectivity, HEC token ACLs, and that the modular input appears in `index=_internal source=*splunkd*`. NULL fields: check props/transforms order and TA version. Fewer results than expected: confirm index allow-lists on the search head role and that `_time` uses the correct timezone. API errors: inspect splunkd.log for HTTP 401/429 from the vendor endpoint configured in inputs.conf.
